meta.title: PetCare Hub | Veterinary medical records centered on your pet
meta.description: PetCare Hub brings together the medical history of dogs and cats across clinics, with Computer Vision and LLM assistance for vets and clear explanations for pet owners.

hero.title: Your pet's health, protected and immutable

how.title: A medical history that goes with your pet
how.lead: Clinical information no longer stays locked in one clinic or on paper that gets lost.
how.step1Text: Create a profile with species, breed, age and weight. Manage several pets from a single account.
how.step2Text: History, diagnosis, lab tests, treatments and prescriptions are recorded along with the responsible professional.
how.step3Text: The longitudinal history is available on the web and in the app, and you share it with the clinics you authorize.

ai.title: LLM Clinical Assistance and Computer Vision
ai.lead: Artificial intelligence tools that speed up each visit without replacing the vet's judgment.
ai.f1Text: Computer Vision detects and highlights areas of interest in skin and eye images to support the clinical exam.
ai.f2Text: Generates a SOAP draft from the current visit and the history the vet selects.
ai.f3Text: Turns diagnoses and treatments into plain language so you understand every instruction.
ai.note: AI does not diagnose: the vet always validates, edits or discards each suggestion.
ai.chatVet: Summarize today's visit for the medical record.
ai.chatAi: SOAP draft: erythema and itching in the abdominal area for 5 days. Suggest ruling out allergic dermatitis and considering a blood count. Pending validation.

faq.title: We answer your questions
faq.q1: Does the artificial intelligence diagnose my pet?
faq.a1: No. AI is a support tool. Computer Vision provides a guidance-only visual analysis and the LLM assistant prepares drafts, but the vet always validates, edits or discards each suggestion.
faq.q2: Is my data and my pet's data safe?
faq.a2: Yes. Access is protected by user and role, and every record stores which professional created it. Only the clinics you authorize can see your pet's history.
faq.q3: Can I use the history at different clinics?
faq.a3: Yes. The history is longitudinal and centered on the pet, not the clinic, so any authorized vet knows its background.
faq.a4: For now PetCare Hub focuses on dogs and cats. Pets are identified by their data and features, no microchip needed.
faq.q5: Do you issue receipts or invoices?
faq.a5: No. Plans are a direct subscription and no SUNAT receipts are issued.
faq.q6: Can I change or cancel my plan?
faq.a6: Yes. You can upgrade by paying only the difference, or cancel anytime from your account.
